name: Askeladden
description: The youngest son, underestimated at home but quick-witted enough to bluff a troll and turn danger into fortune.
visualPrompt: A slim teenage farm boy with tousled hair and alert eyes, wearing simple patched wool clothes and sturdy boots, carrying a small axe and a weathered leather knapsack, calm but mischievous expression

name: The Troll
description: A huge, territorial forest troll who threatens intruders but is easily led by pride and fear of the boy’s supposed strength.
visualPrompt: A massive, hulking troll with a rough, stony complexion, tangled beard, moss and pine needles in its hair, long arms and heavy hands, wary eyes and a bullying posture

name: The Farmer Father
description: A poor, worn-out farmer who pushes his sons to cut timber to pay down debt and scolds cowardice.
visualPrompt: An elderly farmer with a weathered face and gray beard, dressed in coarse work clothes, standing with a tired but stern posture, hands rough from labor

name: The Two Older Brothers
description: The eldest and second sons who mock Askeladden but flee the forest when the troll threatens them.
visualPrompt: Two young adult farm boys in plain work clothes, one taller and one broader, both uneasy and defensive, with worried faces and tense shoulders
